g.text: pidgin
A Tkinter chat window for SoF that reads the game log and talks back through SoFplus cvar files.
Entry points
Core
State
External
`im.exe` · auto-py-to-exe build of `im.py`, hit marker wav bundled
`sofplus/addons/pidgin.func` · `pidgin_init` runs at map load
Enter in the Tk entry · the only input path into the game
tail the log · one thread, every 1 s, from the byte offset in `seekdata`
keep chat lines · only lines with the slot-count prefix reach the widget
paint a line · name coloured by a regex split, `http` tokens clickable
alert · window title set to Unread, hit marker, when the line is not ours
send a line · rewrite `pidgin.cfg` with `msgString` and the slot we think we are
addon poll · every 1000 ms exec the cfg, and `say` the string if it is not empty
learn the slot · on `_sp_cl_info_state` 8, save `_sp_cl_info_slot` for Python
desktop flag · addon renames the player while the window has no focus
`sof.log` · every `say` lands here, appended by the game only
`sofplus/data/pidgin.cfg` · `msgString` and `~slot`, rewritten in place
`sofplus/data/pidgin_desktop.cfg` · one `~desktop` flag, Python writes, addon clears
`seekdata` · byte offset of the last line already shown
SoF.exe · writes the log, runs the addon, owns the window titled `SoF`
SoFplus scripting · `sp_sc_timer`, `sp_sc_exec_file`, `sp_sc_cvar_save`, `say`
`win32gui` · `EnumWindows` for `SoF` and `SoF Console`, foreground check
Tkinter and pygame · the widget, the scrollbar, the hit marker mixer
an appended line
chat only
needs the slot to tell ours apart
the next poll picks it up
cleared and saved after saying
same tick, separate file
two loops, one direction each
the log goes one way, the cvars the other
the game feeds the log and executes the cvars
